# 4-port KiCad project

[Project overview](../../README.md) · [Documentation](../../docs/README.md) · [Local design review](http://localhost:8765/site/)

Native source for two FSI channels plus two reserved generic A02 channels; IGX compatibility is not established.

[Open in KiCad](thor-4port.kicad_pro) · [Schematic PDF](../../exports/4port/schematic.pdf) · [Review exports](../../exports/4port/README.md)

![Paired CAN routing](../../exports/4port/can-routing.svg)

The project includes the schematic, routed board, local symbol/footprint tables and native fabrication rules. `evidence-manifest.json` binds checks to these sources. Review the [pinout proof](../../docs/pinout-proof.md) and [protection scope](../../docs/interface-and-protection.md) before modifying the interface.

CAN trunks use 0.25 mm copper with 0.25 mm straight-section spacing and a protected bottom return corridor. This two-layer/ribbon assembly is not controlled 120 Ω impedance or qualified for a maximum data rate. All removable links are open by default.
